metadata.name: basket
metadata.description: The vault program: a vault per plan, held by its owner

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: The proposed key. Takes the admin over.

instructions.name: cancel_pending
docs: Creator or guardian. Takes back the version that is waiting.

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Owner. One vault per owner per plan id. With a shared portfolio passed, the vault
takes the weights of its version in effect, if that is `expected_version`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Read for the cash mint, which is never a target.

accounts.name: recipe
docs: The shared portfolio to follow. Left out (the program's own id in its place) for a
vault with targets of its own.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Owner. Cash only: the mint must be Config's cash mint. Into the vault's associated
token account.

accounts.name: config
docs: Read for the cash mint. Only the one Config, at its own address.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: The one token account the vault uses for this mint: the associated token account
for (vault, mint, the mint's own token program).

accounts.name: source
docs: Where the tokens come from. The token program checks that the owner may move them.

instructions.name: init_assets
docs: Admin, once. Creates the empty asset list.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Admin, once. The signer must be the program's upgrade authority and becomes the admin.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority. It becomes the admin.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, to find its program data account.

instructions.name: launch
docs: Admin, one way. Locks the router, the price owner and the cash mint, and raises the
floor on the publish delay to two days.

instructions.name: owner_swap
docs: Owner. One trade through Config's router, signed by the vault: at most `max_in` of
the input leaves and at least `min_out` of the output arrives, by the vault's own
count. `data` and the remaining accounts are the router's instruction.

accounts.name: config
docs: Read for the router and the cash mint. Only the one Config, at its own address.

accounts.name: vault_input
docs: What the vault spends from: its associated token account for the input mint.

accounts.name: vault_output
docs: What the vault is paid into: its associated token account for the output mint.

instructions.name: pause_keeper
docs: Guardian. Stops the keeper paths. The owner path reads no such switch.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin. Names the key that may take the admin over.

instructions.name: publish_recipe
docs: Creator. The first version of a shared portfolio; it takes effect at once.

instructions.name: set_cash_mint
docs: Admin, until `launch()`. The one mint a vault takes as a deposit: the chain's dollar
token.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: Admin. Every parameter, inside the hard bounds.

instructions.name: set_price_owner
docs: Admin, until `launch()`. The program that must own a price account for the vault to
read it: Kamino Scope on mainnet, the test price program on devnet.

instructions.name: set_router
docs: Admin, until `launch()`. The one program a vault may swap through: Jupiter on
mainnet, the test exchange on devnet.

instructions.name: set_targets
docs: Owner. The vault's own targets; it stops following a shared portfolio.

accounts.name: config
docs: Read for the cash mint, which is never a target.

instructions.name: unpause_keeper
docs: Admin. Starts the keeper paths again.

instructions.name: update_recipe
docs: Creator. A later version; it takes effect one publish delay later.

instructions.name: upsert_asset
docs: Admin. Lists a token, or rewrites the entry of one that is listed.

accounts.name: mint
docs: A mint of either token program.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Owner. Any token the vault holds, one mint per call, in kind, to a token account the
owner owns. Reads no config, registry or price: nothing but an upgrade can block it.

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: The associated token account for (vault, mint, the mint's own token program).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account of this mint that the vault's owner owns.

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: signer is not the vault's keeper

errors.name: AutoFollowOff
errors.msg: auto-follow is off for this vault

errors.name: KeeperPaused
errors.msg: the keeper is paused

errors.name: MintNotAccepted
errors.msg: mint is not one of the vault's assets

errors.name: RouterNotAllowed
errors.msg: swap target is not the allowed router

errors.name: SpentTooMuch
errors.msg: the vault spent more than max_in

errors.name: ReceivedTooLittle
errors.msg: the vault received less than min_out

errors.name: OtherAccountDebited
errors.msg: another vault token account was debited

errors.name: AccountTampered
errors.msg: owner, delegate, close authority or size changed on a vault token account

errors.name: PriceStale
errors.msg: price is too old

errors.name: PriceDeviation
errors.msg: price is too far from its average

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: the market for this asset is closed

errors.name: MultiplierWindow
errors.msg: within the window around a multiplier change

errors.name: NotTowardTarget
errors.msg: trade does not move the vault toward its targets

errors.name: PastTarget
errors.msg: trade would go past the target

errors.name: Cooldown
errors.msg: asset was traded too recently

errors.name: LossCapReached
errors.msg: weekly loss cap reached

errors.name: AssetNotPriced
errors.msg: asset has no price reference

errors.name: NewAssetNeedsOwner
errors.msg: a new asset needs the owner to accept it

errors.name: VersionNotEffective
errors.msg: version is not in effect yet

errors.name: CreatorLimit
errors.msg: outside the limits for a shared portfolio

errors.name: VersionMismatch
errors.msg: the version is not the one that was reviewed

errors.name: WrongDestination
errors.msg: destination token account does not belong to the vault's owner

errors.name: ParamOutOfBounds
errors.msg: parameter outside its hard bound

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidTargets
errors.msg: too many targets, a mint listed twice or left empty, or weights above 100%

errors.name: NotCashMint
errors.msg: a vault takes deposits in the cash mint only

errors.name: ZeroAddress
errors.msg: the zero address, which is also the system program, is not accepted here

errors.name: LockedAtLaunch
errors.msg: fixed at launch; changing it needs a program upgrade

errors.name: HookNotAllowed
errors.msg: the mint has a transfer hook program

errors.name: AssetListFull
errors.msg: the asset list is full

errors.name: SameMint
errors.msg: a swap needs two different mints

errors.name: NoPendingVersion
errors.msg: no version is waiting

errors.name: NotCreatorOrGuardian
errors.msg: signer is neither the creator nor the guardian

types.name: AdminChanged
docs: Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: AdminProposed
docs: Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: AssetArgs
docs: What the admin chooses for one token. Its decimals are read from the mint.

types.name: AssetEntry
docs: One listed token: 96 bytes. Offsets inside the entry: `mint` 0, `price_slot` 32,
`price_index` 33, `twap_index` 35, `decimals` 37, `price_kind` 38, `session` 39,
`max_weight_bps` 40, `flags` 42, `source_check` 43, `reserved` 75.

fields.name: price_slot
docs: Which of the registry's `price_accounts` holds this asset's price.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Read from the mint when the entry is written.

fields.name: price_kind
docs: 0 none, 1 Scope layout.

fields.name: session
docs: 0 always open, 1 US market hours.

fields.name: max_weight_bps
docs: The most a shared portfolio may hold of it. The registry also caps every weight at 50%.

fields.name: flags
docs: No bit has a meaning yet; must be zero.

fields.name: source_check
docs: All zeros means off (DESIGN-VAULT.md section 5).

types.name: AssetRegistry
docs: The platform's list of tokens a vault may hold: one per program, at seeds ["assets"].
Zero-copy and packed: the bytes are the fields in this order with no padding. 8 bytes of
discriminator, then `price_accounts` at 8, `count` at 136, and entry `i` at `137 + 96·i`.
6,281 bytes in all.

fields.name: price_accounts
docs: The price accounts an entry's `price_slot` points into. Written by the keeper slot.

fields.name: count
docs: How many of `assets` are in use.

types.name: AssetSet
docs: The admin listed a token or changed its entry. Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: CashMintSet
docs: The admin changed the mint a vault takes as a deposit.

types.name: Component
docs: One line of a shared portfolio.

types.name: Config
docs: One per program, at seeds ["config"].

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step hand-over; all zeros when none is pending.

fields.name: router_program
docs: The only program a vault may swap through. Never fixed in code: Jupiter on mainnet,
the test exchange on devnet. Locked once `launched` is set.

fields.name: price_owner
docs: The program that must own a price account. Never fixed in code: Kamino Scope on
mainnet, the test price program on devnet. Locked once `launched` is set.

fields.name: cash_mint
docs: The one mint a vault takes as a deposit: the chain's dollar token. Never fixed in
code: USDC on mainnet, the test dollar token on devnet. Locked once `launched` is set.

fields.name: keeper_paused
docs: Stops the keeper paths only. No owner instruction reads it.

fields.name: launched
docs: One-way; raises the floor on `publish_delay_s` and locks the three addresses above.

fields.name: closed_days
docs: Days since 1970, UTC.

fields.name: bump
docs: The bump of this account's own address, so every read can check the address.

types.name: Followed
docs: The vault now follows a shared portfolio, at this version. Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: KeeperPauseSet
docs: The keeper paths were stopped (by the guardian) or started again (by the admin).

types.name: Launched
docs: The one-way switch was thrown: the three addresses are locked and the publish delay is
at least two days.

types.name: Params
docs: The keeper and registry settings an admin chooses, within the hard bounds in `checks`.

types.name: ParamsSet
docs: The admin changed the parameters.

fields.name: tracked
docs: The balance the vault's token account held when the program last looked. A hint,
not a balance: an issuer with a permanent delegate, or anyone sending tokens in,
changes the real one. Anything that values the vault reads the token accounts.

types.name: PriceOwnerSet
docs: The admin changed the program that must own a price account.

types.name: Recipe
docs: A shared portfolio: one per creator per family, at seeds ["recipe", creator, family_id].
1,022 bytes. Only the version in effect and the one waiting live here; history is in the
`RecipePublished` events.

fields.name: pending
docs: The version that is published and not yet in effect; `version` zero when there is none.

fields.name: last_publish_ts
docs: The time of the last publish, whether or not that version was later cancelled.

fields.name: max_fee_bps
docs: Stored and required to be zero.

fields.name: flags
docs: Stored and required to be zero.

fields.name: vetoed
docs: Not written yet: the guardian's veto is `cancel_pending`.

types.name: RecipePublished
docs: A version of a shared portfolio was published. Same name and fields as the EVM event.

types.name: RecipeVersion
docs: One version of a shared portfolio: 453 bytes. `version` zero means the slot is empty.

fields.name: effective_at
docs: Unix seconds. The version is in effect from this second on.

fields.name: count
docs: How many of `components` are in use.

types.name: RouterSet
docs: The admin changed the program a vault may swap through.

types.name: Target
docs: One line of a vault's targets.

types.name: TargetsSet
docs: The owner set the vault's own targets. Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: Unfollowed
docs: The vault stopped following. Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: Vault
docs: One per owner per plan, at seeds ["vault", owner, basket_id as u64 LE]. It stores the
state and is the authority of the vault's token accounts.
Borsh. The field order is frozen: `owner` is at byte 8, `recipe` at 40,
`accepted_version` at 72 and `auto_follow` at 76, and other code filters on them.

fields.name: recipe
docs: The shared portfolio this vault follows; all zeros when it follows none.

fields.name: accepted_version
docs: The version of `recipe` whose weights the vault took; zero when it follows none.

fields.name: keeper
docs: All zeros means Config's default keeper.

fields.name: count
docs: How many of `positions` are in use.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Byte 0 is the vault type; 0 is the standard vault.

types.name: VaultCreated
docs: Same name as the EVM event.

types.name: VersionCancelled
docs: A waiting version was cancelled, by the creator or the guardian. Same name as the EVM event.
